feed.title: PHP October 2026: what's new
feed.subtitle: PHP news for October 2026, led by the month's big story: two critical security flaws in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, nicknamed php2shell). The current situation in plain words, the core facts with their evidence, what to do, and a briefing for every kind of reader.

entry.summary: GRC: a new section, /grc/, with fractal risk registers for php2shell (34 risks assigned to 53 stakeholders, each joined to its weakness, CVE, fix, code, stories and roles, mapped to 95 controls in 20 frameworks including GDPR, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, DORA, the EU AI Act, ISO 27001 and NIST), and the data protection officer added to the readers with a briefing on exposure, the GDPR 72-hour clock and what to document
